messages:
Maya Ramos: Heads-up — we have a small embeddings model patch that needs to go during tonight's change window. Requesting a soft-exempt from the freeze for a 10m maintenance slot. Patch is v1.3.2 -> v1.3.3, fixes an OOM in short sequences.
Sam Chen: what's the rollback plan if the canary shows degraded recall?
Maya Ramos: rollback plan is standard: immediate unpin to v1.3.2 + disable caching layer for embeds if needed. Will document thresholds.
Liam O'Neill: @Maya can you confirm it’s a binary-compatible quant update (no tokenizer changes)? I want to avoid downstream schema work.
Maya Ramos: Yep — purely inference kernel/quantization tweak. No tokenizer or API surface changes.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: /deploy prod embeddings v1.3.3 --canary 5% --window 2026-04-01T02:00Z:2026-04-01T02:10Z --pin=true
Jen Park: I'll run the smoke set against the canary region (eu-west-1) once canary starts. Will report latency & recall delta within 6 minutes.
Ops SRE: Noted. Ops will monitor token-level latency and error budget. Rollback triggers: 3%+ P99 latency regression OR >1% drop in recall on eval prompt set OR any client 5xx spike.
Sam Chen: Can we add a fallback model route if recall drops? Route to v1.3.1 fallback?
Maya Ramos: Yes, routing rule in console set to fallback->v1.3.1 if recall<0.99 of baseline or errors > threshold.
Liam O'Neill: Release notes snippet for product/marketing: "embeddings: fix OOM in short sequences; improved quant stability for small-batch inference; no API changes." I pushed a draft to the release-notes PR.
Maya Ramos: Thanks. Also requesting an emergency unpin exemption only for this window if we need to hot-unpin. cc @Ops SRE
Ops SRE: Acknowledged. We'll hold the pin override key with on-call. If rollbacks required we'll execute emergency-unpin and post the timeline.
deploy-bot: canary started (eu-west-1) — 5% traffic routing active. Logs: 
```
[00:02:03] canary: 120 reqs, avg latency 78ms, p99 210ms
[00:04:12] embeddings.recall.delta: +0.2% vs baseline
[00:05:59] smoke: 0 failures (small sample)
```
Jen Park: smoke looks good so far. Latency within tolerance. Recall slightly up. :tada:
Sam Chen: keeping an eye on traffic shaping. If any human-facing product signals come in, shout in #incidents and we'll freeze further rollouts.
Maya Ramos: If things stay green at +8m we'll open canary to 30% and then finish ramp to 100% at +20m. Anyone object?
Liam O'Neill: no objections from infra side. Please update the pin table after full rollout.
Ops SRE: ramp plan acknowledged. We'll maintain the rollback watch for the next 45 minutes.
deploy-bot: canary ramp to 30% executed at 3141592728.
Maya Ramos: final note — I updated the runbook with exact rollback commands and the /deploy unpin snippet. Pasting here for quick access:
```
# rollback to v1.3.2
/deploy prod embeddings unpin --version v1.3.2
# emergency rule disable
/redwood route set embeddings --all-traffic-version v1.3.2 --reason "rollback"
```
Jen Park: marking thread resolved once full rollout completes without triggers. Will post final metrics snapshot. :white_check_mark:
